subject: Re: Q3 paid campaign

messages.text: Hi! We'd love to bring you on for a paid campaign this quarter -- full offer and rate card are in the attached PDF.
Thanks for sending this over. Please see the attached file -- that's our answer on the proposal.

gold_rationale: D072 S15/S26: the target explicitly states a decision was reached ('that's our answer'), so this is NOT a bare acknowledgement -- a real position exists. But its content lives entirely in an attachment this benchmark cannot observe. Neutral would falsely claim no substantive decision exists; positive/negative/mixed would fabricate content never authored in visible text. Only ambiguous is honest.

subject: Re: Quick call re: numbers

messages.text: Would love to explore a paid collaboration for our new product line -- are you open to a quick call to discuss numbers?
As we landed on during our call, that's where things stand on our end.

gold_rationale: D072 S15/S26 COMPLETENESS ('the target's side of a phone call is invisible -> prefer ambiguous'): the reply asserts a concrete outcome was reached ('that's where things stand') but the entire substance was exchanged verbally off-record. No authored text states direction. Calling this neutral denies a decision exists; calling it positive or negative invents which one. Ambiguous is the only non-fabricating read.

subject: Two things

messages.text: We'd love to offer you a paid 3-post campaign at $2,000 total -- let us know if you're interested.
Separately, totally unrelated -- could you share your average turnaround time for edited content? Just gathering data for our own planning, no need to decide on the campaign yet.
That won't work for us, sorry -- but thanks for reaching out.

gold_rationale: D072 S3/S27 (mirrors B06 ambiguous_reference, D071): the creator sent two materially different, live antecedents in the same thread -- a paid offer and an unrelated data request. The target's single pronoun ('that') could resolve to either, and each resolution yields a DIFFERENT honest disposition (negative-with-rejection vs. neutral-declining-to-share-data). No textual anchor disambiguates. Silently picking one referent would fabricate a resolution D072 requires to be preserved as ambiguity. The trailing 'thanks for reaching out' is politeness alone and settles nothing (S3).

subject: Re: Seguimiento

messages.text: Hola de nuevo -- ¿alguna novedad sobre la colaboración?
Como ya comenté, seguimos igual de nuestro lado.

gold_rationale: D072 S15: 'como ya comenté' points to an earlier statement never captured anywhere in this observable thread, and 'seguimos igual' ('unchanged') has no fixed polarity without that missing antecedent -- it could mean still-interested-no-change or still-declining-no-change. Unlike a bare 'Ok.', this reply asserts continuity of a specific prior stance that this thread never recorded. No single disposition is supportable without inventing the missing history.

subject: Re: Propuesta de colaboración

messages.text: ¿Tienen ya una respuesta sobre la propuesta de colaboración?
El equipo ya tomó una decisión final al respecto, y quedó registrada en el documento que compartimos por otro canal; nosotros seguimos lo indicado ahí.

gold_rationale: D072 S15/S26: the target states a 'final decision' was made by their team and recorded in material shared through a separate, unnamed channel this thread never contains. A decision demonstrably exists (ruling out neutral's 'nothing was decided' reading) but its direction is entirely inaccessible (ruling out positive/negative/mixed). This is a relayed third-party decision deferred to unavailable external material, distinct from an in-thread attachment reference.

subject: Re: Parceria para o lançamento

messages.text: Adoríamos fechar uma parceria paga com vocês para o lançamento -- podemos marcar uma videochamada para alinhar os detalhes?
Ficou tudo resolvido na nossa videochamada de ontem -- é nisso que ficamos.

gold_rationale: D072 S15/S26 COMPLETENESS, Portuguese: 'ficou tudo resolvido' ('everything got settled') and 'é nisso que ficamos' ('that's what we landed on') both assert a non-directional resolution reached entirely on an unobserved video call. Neither word implies acceptance or refusal specifically. Neutral would deny a resolution exists; any concrete disposition would invent its direction.
